declaration.argument: Only where each function's local values sit in the call frame and how a trace payload's text reaches the trace buffer change. Local slots whose values are never needed at the same time share a frame position, chosen at compile time by liveness with def-against-live-out interference, parameters and entry-live defaults kept; every read returns the value it returns today. Trace payload text is escaped as it is written instead of formatted into scratch and escaped again, producing the same bytes. No draw, container order, value, row or anything the search reads changes. One-thread identity runs on VR (3,008 runs) and Mencius (2,160 runs) against the baseline binary: runs, executions, logs and traces identical both ways, same stall_cap_runs.csv hashes, frame.calls and params_filled identical; differing leaves are only the disclosed frame.slots_built and default_slots_filled, the writer-side text buffer capacity counters, and stats_local.folded_increments raised by the new counters.
